finding: For direct strict pattern B=(2,1,3,5,4) in its remaining mixed-band branch a<t1<t2<b<c<t3<d<t4<t5<e, a single theta in [0,1] selecting F=(-t)(c-t)(((1-theta)t4+theta*t5)-t) uniformly over all stable even boxes and actual atoms is characterized exactly by one 16-ray mixed-envelope Motzkin LP. Correct envelopes are X=(Eplus,Eplus,Eminus,Eminus) and Y=(Eplus,Eplus,Eminus,Eplus). For fixed odd bands [1,4],[7,13],[20,24] and nodes (2,3,10,15,18), theta=1/2 has 16 exact rational direct-ray duals, proving the fixed-data exclusion for all admissible even boxes. An explicit all-seven-positive-width stable box realizes the literal phase-B parity sign sequence and strict E3-band reversal at those same nodes, proving nonvacuity of the difficult placement itself. Universal feasibility of the LP remains open.
